backend: real Gateway, two Identity instances and audit PostgreSQL

checks.name: Password-confirmed enrollment stores only a hash of a distinct 256-bit device credential
Copied device credential, wrong secret and missing proof cannot create a session
Three logout→biometric login cycles retain enrollment while old access/refresh fail and fresh sessions work
Second live Identity instance shares registration and replaces only prior sessions for this device
Another enrolled device keeps an independent valid session
Explicit disable rejects future biometric login while retaining current and other-device sessions
Expired registration is rejected and password-confirmed re-enrollment restores access
Logout-all revokes every device registration and session; normal password login still works

hardwareAcceptance: Requires real user Face ID/Touch ID; no hardware result simulated
